name: events
description: Shared event envelopes, local channels, replay, and delivery transports for Hasna open-source apps. Library class: the SDK exports are the primary surface and the local `events` CLI is the operator seam. Channel state is user-owned JSON under ~/.hasna/events (HASNA_EVENTS_DIR / HASNA_EVENTS_HOME); the package owns no SQL store and provisions no remote infrastructure, so the dual-storage engine gate does not apply to it.

waivedSurfaces.reason: Embedded library plus a local CLI; it owns no HTTP service boundary and ships no serve bin.
Embedded library; MCP execution belongs to the applications that consume these envelopes.
